description: This file contains the code-behind for the UserProfile page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It manages the display of user profile information retrieved from a SQL Server database, handles navigation between pages, and checks for user session authentication.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Partial class for the UserProfile ASP.NET WebForm, managing profile display and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the loading of the user profile page, verifies user session, fetches user data from database, and populates form fields.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click, currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the 'Taken Courses' page.
